trials.claim: Lifetime access to GoBrunch is included with the deal
trials.claimQuote: Connect in the digital age. Get lifetime access to GoBrunch today!
trials.reasoning: One reviewer reports no monthly fees, but another reports activation failure and lost tiers and another only speculates about shutdown; no deal terms confirm lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: Promising software but activation and blank screens it seems like I've lost a multi tier purchase.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports activation failure and loss of paid tiers, undermining lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: Expect a slow painful death of service until one day it just no longer operates.
exhibits.argument: Buyer predicts service shutdown, undermining promise of lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: Easy to use and runs off your browser. No monthly fees, never needed to reach out to support
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms no monthly fees, which supports lifetime access without ongoing payment.

trials.claim: Customers can host unlimited webinars with no installation required
trials.claimQuote: You’ll be able to host unlimited webinars inside of GoBrunch—no installation required for you or your attendees!
trials.reasoning: A reviewer says unlimited access was oversold with inadequate servers making it unacceptable for business, materially limiting unlimited webinars, although another confirms no download is needed.

exhibits.quote: I purchased it to do webinars and it is not fit for purpose.
exhibits.argument: Buyer states product cannot host webinars as claimed.

exhibits.quote: GoBrunch appears to have oversold their unlimited access and refuses to upgrade their servers - resulting in unacceptable results for business purposes.
exhibits.argument: Buyer says unlimited access was oversold and unusable for business due to servers.

exhibits.quote: No download necessary on phone. This is huge, especially if you sometimes meet with people who are less tech-savvy
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms no download is necessary, which supports the no-installation part of the claim.

trials.claim: Previous customers can upgrade license to increase feature limits
trials.claimQuote: Previous AppSumo customers who purchased GoBrunch can upgrade their license to increase their feature limits
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted about previous customers upgrading licenses to increase feature limits.

trials.claim: GoBrunch provides a versatile webinar platform with unique interface for engagement and value
trials.claimQuote: GoBrunch is a versatile webinar platform with a unique interface that provides more engagement and higher value for virtual attendees.
trials.reasoning: Reviews conflict: some praise the unique, engaging, interactive interface, while others find it unintuitive and hard to connect with, so the exhibits do not settle the claim.

exhibits.quote: GoBrunch, unfortunately, falls short of that "intuitive, easy, and smooth" experience I had, especially with Sessions.
exhibits.argument: Buyer says interface is not intuitive, easy and smooth as versatile claim implies.

exhibits.quote: It felt hard to connect with tiny talking heads, rather than automatically showing full-screen for when people take turns talking like in Zoom.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports poor engagement format, undermining higher engagement and value claim.

exhibits.quote: Honestly the thing that appealed to me most about GoBrunch was the fact that it doesn't look like a traditional
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms GoBrunch has a non-traditional meeting room look, supporting a unique interface.

exhibits.quote: GoBrunch creates an environment that is engaging, interactive, and much closer to a real-life experience.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms the platform is engaging and interactive, supporting higher engagement value.

trials.claim: Virtual classroom can be set up in minutes with screen share, camera and broadcast
trials.claimQuote: It only takes a few minutes to set up your virtual classroom with the immediate ability to screen share with sound, enable your camera, and broadcast presenters.
trials.reasoning: Reviews conflict on setup and screen sharing, with one reporting five-minute setup and successful sharing and others reporting labor-intensive setup and missing screen content.

exhibits.quote: You can’t see what you’re recording and the room setup is labor intensive.
exhibits.argument: Buyer says room setup is labor intensive, contradicting setup in minutes.

exhibits.quote: When I share my screen from Photoshop, Illustrator, and other design tools, some buttons and tool panels do not appear to the viewers.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports screen sharing fails to show content, undermining screen share ability.

exhibits.quote: Easy to set up. It took perhaps 5 minutes for a basic orientation, and I'm ready for my first meeting on this platform.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms setup takes about five minutes, supporting setup in minutes.

exhibits.quote: It let me share my screen, the rooms are inviting, the quality of sound is perfect.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms screen sharing works, supporting the screen share capability.

trials.claim: Live sessions support video content, slides, recording and video file downloads
trials.claimQuote: Once the session is live, you’ll be able to play video content, present uploaded slides, record your sessions, and download video files.
trials.reasoning: Exhibits mention recording, including unlimited space but also out-of-sync and over-inclusive recordings, and provide no evidence for video content, slides, or video file downloads.

exhibits.quote: I'm encountering the unpleasant problem of the audio being out of sync when recordings are made.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports recordings have out-of-sync audio, undermining recording support.

exhibits.quote: Here everything you have on your screen is recorded, with the pop-up to stop sharing... EVERYTHING appears.
exhibits.argument: Buyer says recording captures everything unprofessionally, undermining recording value.

exhibits.quote: Add in unlimited recording space and no meeting time limits, and getting GoBrunch is a decision that I would make again and again.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms unlimited recording space, supporting the recording capability.
